visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A dark brown wooden surface displays two gold-rimmed picture frames. The larger frame features a woman with long brown hair and a young girl both pouting playfully; the smaller frame shows a girl in a patterned shirt holding a green leaf to her face. Warm indoor light reflects off the frame glass. (2) A hand with light skin tone enters the frame, lifting a white card decorated with several photographs. The card shows a collage of memories: the woman and girl posing together at a theme park, under a red floral arch, and a panoramic view of a seaside town. The movement is steady. (3) The hand flips the card over to reveal a scrapbook-style back. It contains a photo of the woman and girl riding a bicycle, surrounded by colorful washi tape, heart stickers, and a hand-drawn baguette. There is extensive handwritten text in Chinese. (4) The card remains still, focusing on the handwritten message and stickers. The background frames are out of focus as the camera prioritizes the physical text on the card.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to evoke a sense of nostalgia and familial warmth by showcasing physical manifestations of memories. By transitioning from framed photos to a personalized travel collage and finally a child's handwritten message, it highlights the emotional value of tangible keepsakes and maternal love.
